001package com.streamConverter.path;
002
003import java.util.List;
004import java.util.Objects;
005import java.util.Optional;
006import java.util.regex.Pattern;
007import java.util.stream.Stream;
008
009/**
010 * Type-safe representation of XPath expressions.
011 *
012 * <p>This class encapsulates XPath expressions used for navigating XML documents. It validates the
013 * path syntax at construction time and provides type safety for XML navigation operations.
014 *
015 * <p>This implementation leverages the existing FixedStaXPathHandler validation logic and supports
016 * the same XPath patterns: - Simple element paths: "root/child/grandchild" - No leading or trailing
017 * slashes - No empty segments
018 *
019 * <p>Note: This is a simplified XPath implementation focused on element navigation in
020 * StreamConverter.
021 */
022public class XPath extends AbstractPath<List<String>> {
023
024  private static final String TYPE = "XPath";
025
026  // XML element name pattern for validation
027  private static final Pattern XML_ELEMENT_NAME_PATTERN =
028      Pattern.compile("^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$");
029
030  private final List<String> segments;
031
032  /**
033   * Creates a new XPath instance.
034   *
035   * @param path the XPath expression (e.g., "users/user/name")
036   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the path is null, empty, or has invalid syntax
037   */
038  public XPath(String path) {
039    super(path, TYPE);
040    this.segments = List.of(this.path.split("/"));
041  }
042
043  @Override
044  protected String validateAndNormalize(String rawPath) {
045    if (rawPath == null) {
046      throw new IllegalArgumentException("XPath cannot be null");
047    }
048
049    String trimmedPath = rawPath.trim();
050    if (trimmedPath.isEmpty()) {
051      throw new IllegalArgumentException("XPath cannot be empty");
052    }
053
054    // Normalize path using the same logic as FixedStaXPathHandler
055    String normalizedPath =
056        trimmedPath
057            .replaceAll("^/+", "") // Remove leading slashes
058            .replaceAll("/+$", "") // Remove trailing slashes
059            .replaceAll("/+", "/"); // Collapse multiple slashes
060
061    if (normalizedPath.isEmpty()) {
062      throw new IllegalArgumentException("XPath cannot be just slashes");
063    }
064
065    return normalizedPath;
066  }
067
068  /**
069   * Factory method for creating an XPath from path segments.
070   *
071   * @param segments the path segments (e.g., "users", "user", "name")
072   * @return an XPath constructed from the segments
073   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if segments are invalid
074   */
075  public static XPath fromSegments(String... segments) {
076    if (segments == null || segments.length == 0) {
077      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Path segments cannot be null or empty");
078    }
079
080    for (String segment : segments) {
081      if (segment == null || segment.trim().isEmpty()) {
082        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Path segment cannot be null or empty");
083      }
084    }
085
086    return new XPath(String.join("/", segments));
087  }
088
089  /**
090   * Factory method for creating a single-element XPath.
091   *
092   * @param elementName the element name
093   * @return an XPath for the single element
094   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if elementName is invalid
095   */
096  public static XPath element(String elementName) {
097    if (elementName == null || elementName.trim().isEmpty()) {
098      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Element name cannot be null or empty");
099    }
100    return new XPath(elementName.trim());
101  }
102
103  @Override
104  public void validate() {
105    // AbstractPathから呼ばれる場合、segmentsはまだ設定されていないので、pathを使用
106    List<String> segmentsToValidate = segments != null ? segments : List.of(path.split("/"));
107
108    // Validate no empty segments remain after normalization
109    if (segmentsToValidate.contains("")) {
110      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
111          "XPath must not contain empty segments after normalization: " + path);
112    }
113
114    // Validate each segment is a valid XML element name
115    for (String segment : segmentsToValidate) {
116      if (!isValidXmlElementName(segment)) {
117        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid XML element name: " + segment);
118      }
119    }
120  }
121
122  // === XPath特化メソッド ===
123
124  public int getDepth() {
125    return segments.size();
126  }
127
128  public boolean isDescendantOf(XPath ancestor) {
129    List<String> ancestorSegments = ancestor.getSegments();
130    if (segments.size() <= ancestorSegments.size()) {
131      return false;
132    }
133    return segments.subList(0, ancestorSegments.size()).equals(ancestorSegments);
134  }
135
136  // === AbstractPath実装 ===
137
138  @Override
139  protected boolean doMatches(List<String> currentXmlPath) {
140    if (currentXmlPath == null) {
141      return false;
142    }
143    if (currentXmlPath.size() != segments.size()) {
144      return false;
145    }
146    for (int i = 0; i < currentXmlPath.size(); i++) {
147      if (!currentXmlPath.get(i).equals(segments.get(i))) {
148        return false;
149      }
150    }
151    return true;
152  }
153
154  @Override
155  protected <R> Optional<R> doExtract(Object data, Class<R> resultType) {
156    validateResultType(resultType);
157
158    // XML Document/Element からXPathで値抽出
159    // 実装は javax.xml.xpath.XPath APIを使用予定
160    // ここではモック実装
161    try {
162      if (data instanceof org.w3c.dom.Document) {
163        // XPath評価による値抽出ロジック
164        return extractFromDocument((org.w3c.dom.Document) data, resultType);
165      }
166      return Optional.empty();
167    } catch (Exception e) {
168      return Optional.empty();
169    }
170  }
171
172  @Override
173  protected <R> Stream<R> doExtractAll(Object data, Class<R> resultType) {
174    validateResultType(resultType);
175
176    // 複数マッチするXPath結果をStreamで返す
177    return Stream.empty(); // モック実装
178  }
179
180  private <R> Optional<R> extractFromDocument(org.w3c.dom.Document doc, Class<R> resultType) {
181    // XPath APIを使用した実装予定
182    return Optional.empty(); // モック実装
183  }
184
185  /**
186   * Returns the path segments as an immutable list.
187   *
188   * @return the path segments
189   */
190  public List<String> getSegments() {
191    return List.copyOf(segments);
192  }
193
194  /**
195   * Checks if this is a single-element path.
196   *
197   * @return true if the path has only one segment
198   */
199  public boolean isSingleElement() {
200    return segments.size() == 1;
201  }
202
203  /**
204   * Gets the last element in the path.
205   *
206   * @return the last element name
207   */
208  public String getLastElement() {
209    return segments.get(segments.size() - 1);
210  }
211
212  /**
213   * Gets the first element in the path.
214   *
215   * @return the first element name
216   */
217  public String getFirstElement() {
218    return segments.get(0);
219  }
220
221  /**
222   * Creates a child XPath by appending an element.
223   *
224   * @param childElement the child element to append
225   * @return a new XPath with the child element appended
226   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if childElement is invalid
227   */
228  public XPath child(String childElement) {
229    if (childElement == null || childElement.trim().isEmpty()) {
230      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Child element cannot be null or empty");
231    }
232    return new XPath(path + "/" + childElement.trim());
233  }
234
235  private static boolean isValidXmlElementName(String elementName) {
236    if (elementName == null || elementName.isEmpty()) {
237      return false;
238    }
239
240    // Basic XML element name validation
241    // Must start with letter or underscore, followed by letters, digits, hyphens, periods, or
242    // underscores
243    return XML_ELEMENT_NAME_PATTERN.matcher(elementName).matches();
244  }
245
246  @Override
247  public String toString() {
248    return String.format("XPath('%s')", path);
249  }
250
251  @Override
252  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
253    if (this == obj) return true;
254    if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) return false;
255    XPath xPath = (XPath) obj;
256    return Objects.equals(path, xPath.path);
257  }
258
259  @Override
260  public int hashCode() {
261    return Objects.hash(path);
262  }
263}
